pairs: in the council of the just
Great are the works of the Lord,
Confession and magnificence are his work.
et justitia ejus manet in sæculum sæculi.
And his justice remains from age to age.
He has created a memorial to his wonders;
he is a merciful and compassionate Lord.
He has given food to those who fear him.
memor erit in sæculum testamenti sui.
He will be mindful of his covenant in every age.
Virtutem operum suorum annuntiabit populo suo,
He will announce the virtue of his works to his people,
so that he may give them the inheritance of the nations.
Opera manuum ejus veritas et judicium.
The works of his hands are truth and judgment.
He has sent redemption upon his people.
He has commanded his covenant for all eternity.
Holy and terrible is his name.
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
A good understanding is for all who do it.
laudatio ejus manet in sæculum sæculi.
His praise remains from age to age.
